name: Hare Tokidoki Otenkiame
original_name: 晴れときどきお天気雨
source:
Kasugai Yuuya lives in small town filled with rumors of a "God".
Hardly differing from normal people, a "God" possesses the mysterious power to exterminate ghosts.
If you ask, you may realize your wish - says one of the legends.

One day,  Yuuya, as a member of student government, participated in a new "God"'s welcome party. But somehow, that "God," instead of arriving by train, falls from above on the a head of our hero, clearly showing off her's panties!
Thus, Yuuya's relations with the new unreliable and clumsy "God" started!

------How can I fulfill my wish?

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.clearrave.co.jp/product/hareten/index.html]Official homepage[/url]].
translation:
春日井祐也生活在一座流傳著「神明」傳聞的小鎮。
「神明」與普通人幾乎沒有區別，卻擁有消滅幽靈的神秘力量。
傳說之一稱，只要提出請求，願望或許就會實現。

一天，身為學生會成員的祐也參加了新任「神明」的歡迎會。然而，那位「神明」不知為何沒有乘火車抵達，而是從天而降，砸在主角頭上，還讓他把她的內褲看得一清二楚！
祐也與這個不可靠又笨手笨腳的新「神明」之間的關係，就此開始！

——我要怎樣才能實現自己的願望？

[譯寫自[url=http://www.clearrave.co.jp/product/hareten/index.html]官方網站[/url]].
